name: MCI - The Entrepreneurial School
summary: Business-focused applied-sciences university in Innsbruck; three English bachelor's in business, tourism and an online business degree.

ib.text: Austria accepts the IB Diploma without an equivalence check (ministry). Selection: online application (CV, motivation letter), then an online interview. No IB-specific or English test rule is published.

dates.label: Application deadline, date 1 of 4 for fall 2027

programmes.name: Business & Management
programmes.ib: Compulsory semester abroad in semester 5; optional double degree with Haaga-Helia (Finland) or Northumbria (UK).

programmes.name: Entrepreneurship, Tourism & Leisure Business
programmes.ib: Only the Tourism, Sports & Leisure Business major is held entirely in English; the other major is mainly German. Adds a second foreign language.

programmes.name: Business Administration (Online)
programmes.ib: English track of an online degree: two evening webinars a week plus six to eight campus days in Innsbruck per semester; built for students who work.

notes: There are four application deadlines for fall 2027, and you may apply to more than one program.
All other MCI bachelor's, including the engineering, life-science and social-work degrees, are taught in German.
